about_short_description.short_description: Psylaris offers Innovative VR solutions to boost mental well-being.

product.name: Psylaris Care
product.description: A VR therapy platform offering modules for EMDR, exposure therapy, and relaxation to support mental health treatments.

product.name: EMDR-Remote
product.description: A browser-based application enabling remote EMDR therapy sessions with interactive distraction tasks and exposure videos.

product.name: EMDR-Plus
product.description: A VR-based EMDR module providing intensive distraction tasks and exposure content to enhance trauma therapy sessions.

product.name: Exposure (Virtual Reality Exposure Therapy - VRET)
product.description: A VR module that exposes clients to phobia-related scenarios in a controlled virtual environment to support anxiety treatment.

product.name: Relaxation Module
product.description: A VR-based program offering guided breathing, mindfulness exercises, and games to help clients manage stress and achieve relaxation.

product.name: Data Dashboard
product.description: A web-based dashboard for therapists to monitor client progress and session data from Psylaris treatments without storing personal data.
